z-m-40-07.title: Uma siphakamisa umugqa ovundlile, ingabe amaphoyinti okuhlangana ayanda kuphela?
z-m-40-07.topic: Igrafu ye-quadratic ene-absolute value y=|x²−4| nokuthi inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana nomugqa ovundlile lishintsha kanjani
z-m-40-07.goal: Chaza ukuthi kungani inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana lingaqhubeki nje likhula kodwa lishintsha njengoba ukuphakama k komugqa ovundlile kushintsha, uliphathelanise nesimo segrafu (isiqongo esigoqiwe nephoyinti elithinta i-x-axis).
z-m-40-07.material: Inani lamaphoyinti lapho igrafu yomsebenzi y = |x² − 4| (fundwa: 'the absolute value of x squared minus 4') ihlangana khona nomugqa ovundlile y = k lilingana nenani lezimpande zangempela ezihlukile zesibalo |x² − 4| = k. Ngezansi kunamanani ka-y abaliwe kwamanye amanani ka-x. Uma x ingu-−3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y ingu-5, 0, 3, 4, 3, 0, 5.
z-m-40-07.prereq.0: Izinga elabelwe i-H3 liyizinga lobunzima kuphela kulokhu kusatshalaliswa kokukhiqiza, futhi alisho ukuthi ikharikhulamu ibeka lokhu okuqukethwe ebangeni elithile. Umcabango: usuvele uyayazi igrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic, incazelo ye-absolute value, nencazelo yokuthi izimpande zangempela zesibalo ziyizindawo zokuhlangana kwegrafu nomugqa ovundlile.
z-m-40-07.prereq.1: Izixazululo zesibalo se-quadratic x² = m (ezimbili uma m > 0, eyodwa uma m = 0, akukho uma m < 0)
z-m-40-07.prereq.2: I-absolute value |t| ingu-t uma t ≥ 0 futhi ingu-−t uma t < 0
z-m-40-07.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luyembulwa njengoba k ishintsha. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.0: Landela amanani ethebuleni, bese ubala inani lezikhathi igrafu edlula ngazo endaweni lapho y = k, isikhawu esisodwa ngesikhathi.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa ube izibalo ezimbili x² − 4 = k no-x² − 4 = −k, bese usebenza ukuthi zingaki x ezivela ngayinye.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Okokuqala, dweba umugqa ovundlile y = 1, no-k = 1.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mangaki amaphoyinti ahlukene umugqa ovundlile y = 1 owabelana ngawo negrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.after: |x² − 4| = 1 kusho x² − 4 = 1 noma x² − 4 = −1, ngakho x² = 5 noma x² = 3. x = ±√5, ±√3, okungamaphoyinti angu-4. Ethebuleni, amanani ehla asuka ku-x = 1 (y = 3) aya ku-x = 2 (y = 0), futhi anyuka asuka ku-x = 2 aya ku-x = 3 (y = 5), ngakho ohlangothini lwesokudla uwela u-y = 1 kabili, futhi uhlangothi lwesobunxele luyafana.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi ihlangana njengepheya elilodwa kuphela, kwesobunxele nakwesokudla, njenge-parabola.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi, ulandela isimo samanani ethebula ehla bese enyuka, uwela kabili kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zesobunxele nesokudla.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi, ngenxa yesimo sokuthinta i-x-axis, kwengezwa iphoyinti elilodwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi, njengoba kungekho x ene-y = 1 ethebuleni, abahlangani. Cabanga ngamanani aphakathi kwamasethi ethebula.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Kulesi sikhathi, dweba umugqa ovundlile y = 4, no-k = 4. Ethebuleni, y = 4 uma x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mangaki amaphoyinti ahlukene umugqa ovundlile y = 4 owabelana ngawo negrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Kusukela ku-x² − 4 = 4, x = ±2√2 (amaphoyinti ama-2), futhi kusukela ku-x² − 4 = −4, x = 0 (iphoyinti o-1), futhi awafani, ngakho kunama-3 sekukonke. K = 4 ukuphakama kwengqwebo yengxenye egoqwe phezulu ku-x = 0, ngakho umugqa osicaba uthinta nje ingqwebo.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga ukuthi inani liyafana noma u-k eshintsha.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga okushiya ukuthinta kanye ku-x = 0 futhi kubala kuphela amaphoyinti amabili angaphandle.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lokhu ukucabanga okubala ndawonye iphoyinti elilodwa lokuthinta ku-x = 0 namaphoyinti amabili angaphandle.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga ukuthi, ngoba u-k ube mkhulu, ukuhlangana nako kuyanda.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Ekugcineni, dweba umugqa osicaba u-y = 5, no-k = 5.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Umugqa osicaba u-y = 5 wabelana namaphoyinti amangaki ahlukene negrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Kusukela ku-x² − 4 = 5, x = ±3 (amaphoyinti ama-2), futhi u-x² − 4 = −5 usho ukuthi u-x² = −1, ongenazo izimpande zangempela. Kunama-2 sekukonke. Uma u-k eba mkhulu kuno-4, umugqa osicaba uphakama ngaphezu kwengqwebo egoqiwe, futhi kusala kuphela amagatsha amabili angaphandle.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lokhu ukucabanga ukuthi uma uphakamisa u-k, ukuhlangana kuba kuningi kakhulu.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lokhu ukucabanga okudlulisa inombolo kusukela lapho u-k = 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lokhu ukucabanga ukuthi, njengoba kudlule ukuphakama kwengqwebo okungu-4, akusahlangani. Hlola ukuthi ikhona yini u-x no-y = 5 etafuleni.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lokhu ukucabanga ukuthi uma kuphakama ngaphezu kwengqwebo egoqiwe, kuhlangana kuphela nezindawo ezimbili zangaphandle.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.reflect: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi ukuhlangana kuyanda kuphela uma u-k ephakanyiswa? Chaza ukuthi kungani, uma u-k ephakanyiswa kusukela enanini elincane kakhulu, inani lokuhlangana lishintsha njengo-0 → 2 → 4 → 3 → 2, ukuxhumanisa namaphoyinti egrafu athinta i-x-axis nengqwebo egoqiwe.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.prompt: Njengoba u-k ephakanyiswa kancane kusukela enombolweni encane kakhulu engu-negative, bhala wonke amanani omngcele ka-k lapho inani lokuhlangana lishintsha, futhi uchaze ukuthi umugqa osicaba udlula kuyiphi ingxenye yegrafu emngceleni ngamunye.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.0: Etafuleni, thola inani elincane kakhulu lika-y nokuphakama kwengxenye egoqiwe eduze no-x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.1: Beka u-k ngaphansi nje nangaphezulu nje komngcele, futhi uqhathanise izinombolo zokuhlangana.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi kungani amanani omngcele ka-k enjalo, nokuthi ukuphakama kweliphi iphoyinti kwigrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaphandle komngcele ngamunye (uma u-k ephansi komngcele nalapho ephezulu), ingabe usho ukuthi kunokuhlangana okungaki?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.0: Imingcele ngu-k=0 no-k=4. K=0 ukuphakama kuka-x=±2, lapho umugqa osicaba uthinta i-x-axis, futhi uma uphakama ngaphezu kwalokho, kunokuhlangana okungu-4. K=4 ukuphakama kwengqwebo egoqiwe ku-x=0, ngakho ngaleso sikhathi kunama-3, futhi uma u-k eba mkhulu kuno-4, kusala ama-2 kuphela.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.1: Uma uphakamisa umugqa osicaba, kuqala uthinta igrafu ku-k=0 (ukuhlangana okungu-2), phakathi kuka-0 no-4 kunama-4, ku-k=4 udlula ingqwebo ku-x=0 futhi kunama-3, futhi uma u-k emkhulu kuno-4 uhlangana kuphela nezindawo ezimbili zangaphandle, ngakho kunama-2. Ngakho amanani enza ushintsho ngu-0 no-4.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Lena impendulo efaka nelicala lamaphoyinti angu-0 uma u-k < 0.

z-m-40-04.title: Uhambo olubuyayo, uhambo lokubuya kumele luthuthuke kangakanani ukuze isivinini esimaphakathi?
z-m-40-04.topic: Isivinini esimaphakathi sohambo olubuyayo esivezwe ngomsebenzi we-rational: sishintsha kanjani ngesivinini sendlela yokubuya, nomkhawulo waso
z-m-40-04.goal: Hlola ngezikhathi ukuthi isivinini esimaphakathi sohambo olubuyayo asiyona isilinganiso se-arithmetic samasivinini, bheka umkhawulo wesilinganiso noma isivinini sokubuya siphakanyiswa ngokubikezela nangokubala, bese uthola wena amasivinini afeza umbandela.
z-m-40-04.material: Ibhasi lenza uhambo olubuyayo emgwaqweni ofanayo. Endleleni yokuya lihamba ngesivinini esingashintshi esingu-30 km ngehora, futhi endleleni yokubuya lihamba ngesivinini esingashintshi esingu-x km ngehora. Ibanga lendlela eyodwa D km alaziwa, futhi azikho ukumisa endleleni. Isivinini esimaphakathi sichazwa njengo-(ibanga eliphelele elihanjiwe) ÷ (isikhathi esiphelele esithathiwe).
z-m-40-04.thinking.0: Ukulungisa ukubikezela okuvela emqondweni ngolwazi olusha
z-m-40-04.thinking.1: Ukufunda umumo wenguquko (omkhulu ekuqaleni, bese uncipha kancane kancane)
z-m-40-04.prereq.0: Izinga elabelwe H3 liyizinga lobunzima kuphela kulokhu kusatshalaliswa kokukhiqiza, futhi aliyisho ukuthi uhlelo lokufunda lubeka lokhu okuqukethwe ebangeni elithile. Ukucabanga: usevele wazi isivinini = ibanga ÷ isikhathi nokuthi ubala kanjani ngezinkulumo zezingxenye.
z-m-40-04.prereq.1: Ukubala ngezinkulumo ze-rational (izingxenye), nomuzwa wokuthi ingxenye iba incane njengoba isihlukanisi sakhula
z-m-40-04.prereq.2: Umvumelwano wokuthi isivinini esimaphakathi = ibanga eliphelele ÷ isikhathi esiphelele esithathiwe
z-m-40-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luzembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha ukuthi isivinini esimaphakathi sohambo olubuyayo sizoba yini.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.0: Misa ibanga lendlela eyodwa libe inani elithile elifana no-60 km, bese uthola isikhathi esithathiwe endleleni yokuya nendleleni yokubuya ngokwehlukana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ngemva kokuthola ibanga eliphelele lohambo olubuyayo nesikhathi esiphelele esithathiwe, hlola ukuthi umphumela uyashintsha yini uma ushintsha ibanga lendlela eyodwa libe elinye inani.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Thatha usuku lapho isivinini endleleni yokubuya sasingu-60 km ngehora njengesibonelo. Ibanga lendlela eyodwa D alikaziwa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Isivinini esimaphakathi sohambo olubuyayo sasingaba yini ngalolu suku?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Uma D = 60 km, indlela yokuya ithatha 60 ÷ 30 = 2 amahora futhi indlela yokubuya ithatha 60 ÷ 60 = 1 ihora, ngakho uhambo olubuyayo lwangu-120 km lwathatha amahora angu-3. Isivinini esimaphakathi singu-120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h. Umphumela ofanayo uphuma kwamanye amanani ka-D (D iyasuka). Singaphansi kuka-45 ngoba isikhathi esiningi sichithwe sigijima ngesivinini esiphansi.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lokhu kucabanga kuthatha isilinganiso se-arithmetic samasivinini (maphakathi kuka-30 no-60) njengesivinini esimaphakathi.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kucabangela ukuthi isikhathi esiningi sichithwe sigijima ngesivinini esiphansi.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga ukuthi ingxenye esheshayo inomthelela omkhulu. Qhathanisa isikhathi esithathiwe engxenyeni ngayinye.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Asazi D, ngakho asikwazi ukwazi isivinini esimaphakathi nakho
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lokhu kucabanga ukuthi ungabala kuphela uma ibanga liyinani elithile. Zama ukusetha D ibe ngu-60 bese uqhathanisa nanamanye amanani.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Bheka usuku lapho isivinini endleleni yokubuya sakhuphuka saba ngu-120 km ngehora.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Isivinini endleleni yokubuya siphindeke kabili (60 → 120). Isivinini esimaphakathi sizoshintsha kanjani kusukela ku-40 km/h?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma D = 120 km, indlela yokuya ithatha amahora angu-4 futhi indlela yokubuya ithatha ihora elingu-1, ngakho isamba singu-240 ÷ 5 = 48 km/h. Noma isivinini siphindeke kabili, isilinganiso sandile ngo-20% kuphela. Lokhu kungoba isikhathi esithathiwe endleleni yokuya sihlala sinjalo, ngakho isikhathi esiphelele asehli sibe isigamu.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Iyanda cishe ibe kabili, isondele ku-80 km/h
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi uma isivinini sohambo lokubuya siphindeka kabili, isilinganiso naso siphindeka kabili ngokulingana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Isilinganiso sesivinini cishe asishintshi futhi sihlala eduze no-40
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi ushintsho esivinini sohambo lokubuya cishe aluthinti isilinganiso.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Iyanda isuka ku-40 kodwa ayifinyeleli ukuphindeka kabili
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lo ngumcabango ocabangela ukuthi isikhathi esithathiwe ohambweni lokuya sihlala sifana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iba ngu-30 km/h, ofana nesivinini sohambo lokuya
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi ingxenye esheshayo iyaqedana esilinganisweni.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Noma isivinini sohambo lokubuya sinyuswa saya ku-300 km ngehora, isilinganiso sesivinini sicishe sibe ngu-54.5 km/h.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Cabanga ukuthi isivinini sohambo lokubuya singenziwa sibe sikhulu njengoba ufisa, ingabe kungenzeka ukuthi isilinganiso sesivinini sohambo lokuya nokubuya sifinyelele ku-60 km ngehora?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Isilinganiso sesivinini singu-60x ÷ (30 + x). Isikhathi sohambo lokuya sesivele sisetshenzisiwe, ngakho noma isikhathi sohambo lokubuya senziwa sisondele ku-0, isilinganiso sisondela kuphela ku-2D ÷ (D/30) = 60 futhi asifinyeleli kulo. Uma x = 150 kungu-50, uma 300 kungu-54.5 cishe, futhi uma 600 kungu-57.1 cishe.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Uma ugijima ngokushesha okwanele ohambweni lokubuya, ekugcineni ungafinyelela kulo
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi uma unyusa isivinini, isilinganiso naso siyanyuka ngaphandle komkhawulo.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Uma isivinini sohambo lokubuya singu-90 km ngehora, siba ngu-60 ncamashi
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi kuyahambisana ncamashi ngesivinini esithile. Bala wena isilinganiso uma isivinini singu-90 km ngehora.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kufika isikhathi lapho kufinyelela ku-60; akusona nje ngokoqobo
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lo ngumcabango othatha inani lomkhawulo njengenani elingafinyelelwa. Sebenza ukuthi isikhathi kumele sithathe isikhathi esingakanani ukuze isilinganiso sibe ngu-60.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lo ngumcabango ocabangela ukuthi isikhathi esithathiwe ohambweni lokuya sesivele simisiwe.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ungase ucabange ngesilinganiso sesivinini njengesilinganiso sezivinini (45). Yimuphi ulwazi (isikhathi esithathiwe) oluguqule lowo mcabango? Chaza isimo lapho isilinganiso sikhuphuka uma unyusa isivinini sohambo lokubuya (esikhulu ekuqaleni, bese siba sincane kakhulu) nokuthi kungani umkhawulo ongu-60 uvela.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isivinini x sohambo lokubuya (km ngehora) ukuze isilinganiso sesivinini sohambo lokuya nokubuya sibe kusukela ku-50 km ngehora kuya ku-55 km ngehora, bese uthola amanani angu-3 ahlukene ka-x. x inombolo ephelele eyiphozithivu, futhi isivinini sohambo lokuya singu-30 km ngehora.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.hint.0: Lungisa ibanga lohambo olulodwa libe linye, faka amanani esivinini x sohambo lokubuya, bese ubala isilinganiso sesivinini.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha x ibe ngu-100, 200, 300 njalonjalo, bese unciphisa ukuya lapho isilinganiso sesivinini siwela khona phakathi kuka-50 no-55.

z-m-40-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Isilinganiso sesivinini singaphansi kuka-50. Bala futhi isilinganiso ezikhathini ezithathiwe ohambweni lokuya nolokubuya.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Isilinganiso sesivinini sikhulu kuno-55. Bala futhi isilinganiso.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.explain: Isilinganiso sesivinini singu-60x ÷ (30 + x), futhi amanani ka-x lapho singu-50 kuya ku-55 asukela ku-150 kuya ku-330. Njengoba x iba nkulu, isilinganiso siyanda kodwa siyalingana eduze no-60, ngakho ibanga lika-x elivunyelwe libanzi.

z-m-40-05.title: Umsebenzi we-radical onesiphetho (−2, 1): kukhona ifomula eyodwa kuphela?
z-m-40-05.topic: Umsebenzi we-radical y=√(ax+b)+c: inkululeko esalayo uma ifomula imiswa ulwazi lwesiphetho
z-m-40-05.goal: Hlulela ukuthi ulwazi lwesiphetho esisodwa lunquma zingaki izinto ezimisiwe zomsebenzi we-radical futhi lushiya zingaki, yakha wena amafomula ahlukile anelisa isimo, bese uchaza ukuthi yini enye edingekayo ukunquma ijika ngokuhlukile.
z-m-40-05.material: Esikrinini seklasi, igrafu yomsebenzi we-radical y = √(ax + b) + c (fundwa: 'square root of a x plus b, plus c') yavela. Ijika linesiphetho saso sesobunxele ku-(−2, 1) futhi lisuka lapho liya phezulu ngakwesokudla. a, b, c ziyizinto ezimisiwe, futhi njengoba linwebela ngakwesokudla, a > 0. Akwaziwa ukuthi yimaphi amanye amaphoyinti ijika elidlula kuwo.
z-m-40-05.prereq.0: Izinga elabelwe i-H3 liyizinga lobunzima kuphela kulokhu kusatshalaliswa kokukhiqiza, futhi alisho ukuthi ikharikhulamu ibeka lokhu okuqukethwe ebangeni elithile. Umcabango: usuvele uyazi ukuthi igrafu yomsebenzi we-radical y = √(ax + b) + c iqala esiphethweni futhi inwebela ohlangothini olulodwa.
z-m-40-05.prereq.1: Izinombolo ezinempande eyisikwele eyinombolo ephelele (izikwele eziphelele)
z-m-40-05.prereq.2: Ukubala ukuthola inani lika-y ngokufaka x = k efomulani
z-m-40-05.s.s1.prompt: Ingabe kungenzeka ukuthi a, b, c zonke zinqunywa ngokuhlukile ulwazi kuphela lokuthi isiphetho ngu-(−2, 1)?
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi inani elingaphakathi kwempande kumele libe yini uma ufaka i-x-coordinate yesiphetho, −2, efomulani √(ax + b) + c.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yakha amafomula amabili anesiphetho esifanayo kodwa u-a ohlukile, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi amagrafu ayafana yini.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.a: c inqunyiwe kodwa a isasele, futhi b inqunywa ngu-a

z-m-40-08.title: Uma sazi kuphela ukuthi u-f(1) = f(5), ingabe umsebenzi we-quadratic uyedwa?

z-m-40-08.goal: Qonda ukuthi amaphoyinti amabili anenani lomsebenzi elifanayo amisa kuphela i-axis ye-symmetry yomsebenzi we-quadratic hhayi umsebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi kungase kungamiswa ube munye noma ngemibandela eyengeziwe, futhi wahlukanise imibandela enikeza ulwazi olusha nalena engasikho.
z-m-40-08.material: Kumsebenzi we-quadratic u-f(x) = ax² + bx + c (a ≠ 0), kwaziwa kuphela iqiniso lokuthi u-f(1) = f(5). (Ifundwa ngokuthi: 'f ka-1 no-f ka-5 bayalingana'.) USeonwoo wathi, “Kunamaphoyinti amabili anenani elifanayo, ngakho u-f umiswe ube munye.”

Isicabango: usuvele uyazi i-symmetry yesobunxele nesokudla yegrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic nefomula esimeni u-f(x) = a(x − p)² + q.

UJia uthe, “Inombolo ephezulu x² − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1), futhi uma ususa, iba ngu-x + 1, ngakho f no-g umsebenzi ofanayo futhi amagrafu abo afanayo.”

Ukucabanga: usevele wazi ukuhlukanisa ngezici, ukususa izinkulumo zezingxenye, nomvumelwano wokuthi idomeyini yomsebenzi yizo zonke izinombolo zangempela lapho inkulumo ingabalwa.

z-m-40-09.title: Ngamadolobhana amabili nangamadolobhana amathathu, isitobhi sebhasi kufanele siye kuphi?
z-m-40-09.topic: Isamba semisebenzi yenani eliphelele: igrafu yomugqa ophukile wesamba samabanga S(x) nalapho kuncane kakhulu
z-m-40-09.goal: Qonda ukuthi isamba samabanga aya emadolobhaneni amabili sinengaphansi eliyisicaba, ngakho isikhundla sokuncane kakhulu siyizindawo eziningi, qinisekisa ukuthi ngamadolobhana amathathu isikhundla sokuncane kakhulu simiswa sibe yindawo eyodwa, futhi ubikezele wena icala lamadolobhana amane.
z-m-40-09.material: Emgwaqweni oqondile, izikhundla ziveza nge-x km. Idolobhana A lise-x = 2 futhi idolobhana B lise-x = 6. Sifuna ukwakha isitobhi sebhasi esisodwa esikhundleni u-x emgwaqweni. Uma isamba samabanga kusuka esitobhini kuya edolobhaneni ngalinye kungu-S(x), khona-ke u-S(x) = |x − 2| + |x − 6|. (Kufundwa: 'inani eliphelele lika-x ukhipha 2, ukwengeza inani eliphelele lika-x ukhipha 6'.) Isitobhi singakhiwa noma kuphi emgwaqweni.

Isicabango: usuvele uyazi ukuhumusha kokuthi inani eliphelele u-|x − p| libanga phakathi kuka-x no-p emgqeni wezinombolo.

z-m-40-10.title: Uma amanani etafuleni elingana ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, ingabe igrafu iyi-symmetric nayo?
z-m-40-10.topic: I-symmetry yegrafu yomsebenzi mayelana ne-y-axis: amandla obufakazi bokuthi amapheya ambalwa amanani alingana, nokwakha izibonelo eziphikisayo
z-m-40-10.goal: Ngokusekelwe encazelweni ye-symmetry mayelana ne-y-axis (f(−x) = f(x) kuwo wonke u-x), qonda ukuthi itafula elibonisa amapheya ambalwa amanani alinganayo alikwazi ukunquma i-symmetry, futhi wakhe isibonelo esiphikisayo wena kusuka kumsebenzi ohambisana nelitafula ngqo kodwa ongeyona i-symmetric.
z-m-40-10.material: Ifomula yomsebenzi u-f ayaziwa, futhi kunetafula elinamanani ku-x ambalwa kuphela. Uma u-x engu-−2, −1, 0, 1, 2, u-f(x) ungu-4, 1, 0, 1, 4. Amanani ku-x angekho etafuleni awaziwa. Umkhakha wazo zonke izinombolo zangempela, futhi “i-symmetric mayelana ne-y-axis” kusho ukuthi u-f(−x) = f(x) uyabamba kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela u-x. UJiho wathi, “Etafuleni amanani ku-x no-−x ayalingana, ngakho igrafu ka-f iyi-symmetric mayelana ne-y-axis.”

Isicabango: usuvele uyazi incazelo ye-symmetry mayelana ne-y-axis (uma iphoyinti u-(x, y) likhona, u-(−x, y) ukhona futhi) nendlela yokubala amanani ama-polynomial.

z-m-40-10.s.s3.prompt: Imisebenzi u-g(x) = x² + c·x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) (u-c uyisiqhubekayo) inelisa amanani etafula ngqo ku-x = 0, ±1, ±2 (0; 1, 1; 4, 4) (hlola ngokufaka amanani wena). Yakha ubufakazi bokuthi eminye yale misebenzi ayiyona i-symmetric: khetha inombolo ephelele engeyona u-0 u-c (−3 ≤ c ≤ 3) nenombolo ephozithivu u-t ukuze u-g(t) ≠ g(−t), futhi uthole ama-(c, t) ama-2 ahlukene.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.0: Lungisa u-c oyedwa no-t, bala u-g(t) no-g(−t) ngokuhlukile, bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka u-t njengenani elisethebuleni (1, 2) nanjengenani elingekho ethebuleni (njengo-3).
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c1: U-c uyinombolo ephelele engesiyo u-0 kusuka ku-−3 kuya ku-3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c1: U-c kumele abe yinombolo ephelele engesiyo u-0 kusuka ku-−3 kuya ku-3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c3: U-g(t) no-g(−t) bahlukile. Lobu bufakazi bokuthi akuhambisani ne-y-axis.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Kule t, u-g(t) no-g(−t) bayafana. Linani lesethebuleni noma inani lapho baphuma belingana. Hlola elinye u-t.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.explain: U-x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) ungu-0 ku-x = 0, ±1, ±2, ngakho amanani ethebula asala eyafana, kodwa uma u-x esikhundleni sika-−x, uphawu luba luphambene. Ngakho uma u-t engesiyo u-1 noma 2, u-g(t) no-g(−t) bahluka ngo-2 izikhathi u-c·t(t² − 1)(t² − 4). Lesi sibonelo esiphikisayo sikhombisa ukuthi amanani amahlanu ethebula odwa awakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana.
